accept.description: Comma-separated extensions or MIME types. Empty hides the attachment surface.

attach-label.description: Accessible name of the file picker button.

attachments-label.description: Accessible name of the attachment list.

disabled.description: Excludes the composer from interaction and native form data.

file-count-message.default: '{name} exceeds the maximum number of attachments.'
file-count-message.description: Localized count rejection. The {name} marker is replaced with the file name.

file-size-message.description: Localized size rejection. The {name} marker is replaced with the file name.

file-type-message.description: Localized type rejection. The {name} marker is replaced with the file name.

label.description: Required accessible name of the text field. Supply it even with a placeholder.

max-files.description: Maximum count of attached files. Omit for no count limit.

max-size.description: Maximum attachment size in bytes per file. Omit for no size limit.

name.description: Optional key for the text in native form data. Files are carried by ki-submit.

placeholder.description: Hint displayed while the text field is empty.

remove-label.description: Prefix of an attachment's remove button name, followed by the file name.

send-label.description: Accessible name of the Send button.

status.description: Application-owned request state. Only idle can send; streaming exposes Stop.

stop-label.description: Accessible name of the Stop button.

submit-on.description: Send with Enter or with Control/Command+Enter. Shift+Enter always adds a line.

value.description: Current draft text; the value attribute provides the form reset default.

writing-message.description: Visible polite status while the assistant streams.

--ki-button-ghost-neutral-hover-bg.description: color used by the button component for ghost neutral hover background.

--ki-button-ghost-neutral-hover-fg.description: color used by the button component for ghost neutral hover foreground.

--ki-button-ghost-neutral-rest-bg.description: color used by the button component for ghost neutral rest background.

--ki-button-ghost-neutral-rest-fg.description: color used by the button component for ghost neutral rest foreground.

--ki-button-primary-neutral-disabled-bg.description: color used by the button component for primary neutral disabled background. Deliberate deviation: Figma disabled is Surface/disabled_base_em gray.100 with gray.400 text (≈1.4:1); Kimen keeps gray.200 for contrast (precedent 010 D2, pending founder ratification).

--ki-button-primary-neutral-disabled-bor.description: color used by the button component for primary neutral disabled border.

--ki-button-primary-neutral-disabled-fg.description: color used by the button component for primary neutral disabled foreground. Deliberate deviation: Figma disabled text is text/base_em gray.400 (≈1.4:1 on gray.100); Kimen keeps text.muted gray.700 for readable disabled text (precedent 010 D2, pending founder ratification).

--ki-button-primary-neutral-rest-bg.description: color used by the button component for primary neutral rest background (MarsUI Surface/primary_med_em, brand 500).

--ki-button-primary-neutral-rest-border.description: color used by the button component for primary neutral rest border (MarsUI top/inline edge; none in onmars v2).

--ki-button-primary-neutral-rest-fg.description: color used by the button component for primary neutral rest foreground.

--ki-button-secondary-neutral-rest-bg.description: color used by the button component for secondary neutral rest background (MarsUI Surface/special/secondary_alpha_base: neutral, not a brand tint; white in onmars v2).

--ki-button-secondary-neutral-rest-borde.description: color used by the button component for secondary neutral rest border (MarsUI top/inline edge).

--ki-button-secondary-neutral-rest-fg.description: color used by the button component for secondary neutral rest foreground (MarsUI text/high_em).

--ki-button-sm-radius.description: dimension used by the button component for sm radius (Button master 8003:300 binds Radius/small-component/sm, the scale a radius mode reassigns).

--ki-control-size-sm.description: Small control track height, 32 CSS px at the default root size.

--ki-density-control-offset.description: Added to the block size of every scaled control and row (button, icon button, field, select, textarea, option, list item, tab). Components floor the result at ki.size.target-min.

--ki-density-space-scale.description: Multiplies every scaled container padding and gap (card, dialog, alert, list, list item, select listbox, tab panel, tooltip).

--ki-density-target-min.description: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).

--ki-focus-ring-color.description: Colour of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws: 3:1 or more against the page in every theme and scheme.

--ki-focus-ring-offset.description: Gap between a focusable component and its keyboard focus ring.

--ki-focus-ring-width.description: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws (its outline). One token instead of one per component, so a mode or a theme changes every ring at once.

--ki-icon-button-sm-icon-size.description: dimension used by the icon button component for sm icon size (MarsUI Placeholder_sm 18px).

--ki-prompt-input-action-gap.description: Default spacing between attachments and toolbar controls.

--ki-prompt-input-backdrop-filter.description: Optional whole backdrop filter behind the composer.

--ki-prompt-input-bg.description: Raised surface behind the prompt composer.

--ki-prompt-input-bg-image.description: Optional background image painted above the composer surface.

--ki-prompt-input-editor-padding-block.description: Block inset for the native text field and its sizer.

--ki-prompt-input-editor-padding-inline.description: Inline inset for the native text field and its sizer.

--ki-prompt-input-feedback-bg.description: Surface immediately behind attachment rejection text.

--ki-prompt-input-feedback-fg.description: Attachment rejection text on the composer surface.

--ki-prompt-input-fg.description: Draft text on the composer surface.

--ki-prompt-input-max-height.description: Maximum height of the draft before the textarea scrolls.

--ki-prompt-input-min-height.description: Minimum height of the editable draft.

--ki-prompt-input-padding.description: Inset and spacing between rows in the composer.

--ki-prompt-input-placeholder-fg.description: Placeholder and writing status on the composer surface.

--ki-prompt-input-radius.description: Corner radius of the composer surface.

--ki-typography-family-body.description: semantic font family for typography family body.

--ki-typography-line-height-body-2.description: semantic dimension for typography line height body 2.

--ki-typography-line-height-caption-2.description: semantic dimension for typography line height caption 2.

--ki-typography-size-body-2.description: semantic dimension for typography size body 2.

--ki-typography-size-caption-2.description: semantic dimension for typography size caption 2.

component.description: A multiline assistant composer with local file attachments and send and stop requests.

ki-stop.description: Requests that the application stop its streaming response.

ki-submit.description: Requests a send with original text and a snapshot of accepted local files.

actions.description: The toolbar with attachment, tool and message actions.

feedback.description: The polite announcement for rejected attachments.

status.description: The polite announcement for the streaming state.

stop.description: The native Stop button, visible while streaming.

tools.description: The container for the tools slot.

attachmentsLabel.description: Accessible name of the attachment list.

disabled.description: Excludes the composer from interaction and native form data.

fileCountMessage.description: Localized count rejection. The {name} marker is replaced with the file name.

fileSizeMessage.description: Localized size rejection. The {name} marker is replaced with the file name.

fileTypeMessage.description: Localized type rejection. The {name} marker is replaced with the file name.

label.description: Required accessible name of the text field. Supply it even with a placeholder.

maxFiles.description: Maximum count of attached files. Omit for no count limit.

maxSize.description: Maximum attachment size in bytes per file. Omit for no size limit.

name.description: Optional key for the text in native form data. Files are carried by ki-submit.

placeholder.description: Hint displayed while the text field is empty.

removeLabel.description: Prefix of an attachment's remove button name, followed by the file name.

sendLabel.description: Accessible name of the Send button.
